hq 0.79.0: headquarters for the z- sessions. Every command takes --json.

  hq status                                   the open item, what is next and why it waits
  hq version [--json]                         hq's version and schema, and the commit the installed binary was built from
  hq capabilities [--json] [--require X.Y.Z]  commands, JSON shapes, version; --require fails if hq is older
  hq open [id] [--force]                      open the next call or proposal (one at a time)
  hq hold --reason TEXT | hq release          hold the queue, or let it go
  hq band                                     the fleet in one line: needs you, Nix, lanes, CI, reviews (the z-stu band reads --json)
  hq pane                                     the detail behind the band: needs you with links, Nix today, lanes, reviews, shipped today, news (z-stu's /hq pane reads --json)
  hq whois <session-id>                       the declared fleet name hq fleet last saw under a session id
  hq pins                                     pinned atc sessions, longest idle first
  hq console [--port N]                       a local page to answer calls, proposals and to-dos (prints a one-use login link in your own terminal)
  hq console login                            ask the running console to print a new one-use login link on its own terminal

  hq restart [--force]                        restart the atc daemon (detached), then wake
  hq wake [--dry-run] [--wait SECONDS]        message the sessions the last restart cut off
  hq wake list | add <session> [--note T] | remove <session> | import <file>

  hq review <[owner/]repo> <pr> [--no-watch] [--repo-dir D] [--effort high|medium] [--full] [--fixes-only]  review in a worktree, then CI and open threads: noslop for repos on the noslop list (--full: the whole PR, not only what changed since the last review; --fixes-only: a plain pass-through to the fix checks of noslop, no new findings and not counted as a round; past the emergency cap of a repo, hq runs fix checks only by itself), else Codex (effort by risk, allow-or-deny pass only for a gate change)
  hq review gate <[owner/]repo> <pr> [--repo-dir D]  may the PR merge: exit 0 on green CI plus, for a noslop PR, a review on record and no open finding (or the owner's override at this head), else merge_blocked with the reason
  hq pr status <[owner/]repo> <pr> | answer <repo> <pr> lgtm|changes|reject --source S [--note T] | override <repo> <pr> --source S --note T | accept-risk <repo> <pr> <finding-id> --source S --note T | mechanical <repo> <pr> | exempt <repo> <pr> --rule R --note T | next <repo> <pr> <session>|--clear   the PR's record (gate, the owner's answer, who holds the next step; stale when the head moved): read it before you message a session about a PR
  hq noslop [on|off <repo...> | cap <repo> <n|off> | pin <sha> [--force <reason>] | report [--since ISO]]   the repos noslop reviews, each repo's emergency review cap, the pinned commit and its clone
  hq repair advisor-400 <session> | --file T.jsonl [--apply]  mend a stopped Claude session that fails every turn with "unexpected tool_use_id found in advisor_tool_result blocks"; dry run unless --apply, backup first
                                             (checkout: --repo-dir, ~/projects/<repo>, else hq's own clone)

  hq run add <issue> --title T [--session ID] [--where imp|local|none] [--next T] [--gate T] [--geoff-chat] [--ready-since TIME] [--size S|M|L|XL --lines N] [--lane LANE]
  hq run size <issue> --size S|M|L|XL --lines N   triage's size guess (lines changed, tests included)
  hq run list [--all] | show <issue|session> [--notes N] | watchlist [--write FILE] | sweep
  hq run session <issue> <id> [--add|--remove] a relaunch (new main session), or a helper joins/leaves
  hq run lane <issue> (<lane> | --lane LANE)   set a run's delivery lane (pacing.json lanes)
  hq run place <issue> imp|local|none [--note T]  move an open run to where its session runs; the lanes count it there
  hq run reopen <issue> [--next T]   a done or dropped run back to working
  hq run state <issue> <working|blocked|merged|deploying|deploy-held|live-check> [--next T] [--waits-on T|none] [--waits-on-geoff|--not-geoff] [--check owed|none] [--force]
  hq run check <issue> owed|none    whether a live check is owed once the release ships (unset counts as owed; none sends the run to done)
  hq run ship [--dry-run]            one release pass now: a run whose merged PRs all shipped in a release moves to live-check, or done when no check is owed (the watcher does it every 10 min)
  hq run done|drop <issue> [--note T] | next|gate|title <issue> <text> | geoff-chat <issue> on|off
  hq run pr <issue> <repo#n|URL> | final <pr> --sha S [--fixed N] [--followups GEO-1,GEO-2] | reviewing <pr> | reviewed <pr> --sha S [--recheck]
  hq run merged|closed <pr> | note <issue|session> <text> [--label L]
  hq run unmerge <pr> [--reason T]   undo a wrong merged mark: the PR is open again in hq (hq run merged asks GitHub first)
  hq run unfinal <pr> [--reason T]   clear a final mark the head has moved past; the sweep stops flagging the PR until the next final

  hq lanes [status|log] [--limit N]           watcher state, nudges and whether slots dropped
  hq lanes start [--interval SECONDS] | stop  install, enable and start the watcher unit (default every 300s); stop disables it
  hq lanes tick                               one look now
  hq lanes promotable                         Backlog issues with every blocker Done and every section filled, not parked
  hq stats [--since 7d|36h|TIME] [--around MARK]   numbers someone acts on: waits on the owner, merge to live, idle capacity, flow
  hq answers [--since 7d|36h|TIME]   the owner's answers in the window: calls, proposals, console reviews and typed lines (--json for the weekly audit)
  hq kinds [--weeks 8] | hq kinds sync [--weeks 8]   bug share per Sydney week: merged PRs by title kind and by Linear issue type, closed issues by type; sync backfills from GitHub and Linear
  hq linear issues --team KEY --state NAME[,NAME...] [--updated-since TIME] [--fields LIST] --out DIR  write the team's issues in those states to DIR/issues-N.json, 100 to a page, for the triage scripts to read
  hq goals [--days 14] | hq goals sync [--days 14]   team goals per Sydney day and week: cloud deploy-prod runs, z-delivery DEPLOY/HOLD, CI runs, failures, cancels, re-runs and minutes, PRs merged and closed unmerged
  hq goals targets | hq goals target <goal> <op> <value> | <goal> none   the 7 goals' targets (bugs, features, deploys, downtime, ciwaste, mustfix, cost); op is one of < <= >= >; none clears
  hq goals weekly [--dry-run] | hq goals weekly skip [DATE] --reason T   the Monday 17:00 Sydney goals review to z-stu: print it, send it now, or leave a Monday alone
  hq goals account [KEY NAME|none]           name a Claude usage account (KEY is 12 hex characters; NAME a slug of 24 characters at most); with no arguments lists the names
  hq goals daily [--dry-run] | hq goals daily skip [DATE] --reason T   the 18:00 Sydney goals check-in to z-stu: print it, send it now, or leave a day alone
  hq defs [status] | hq defs setup hq|private | hq defs check [hq] | hq defs use hq | hq defs sync   where the fleet's skills (hq-defs) and start prompts (hq-private) come from; sync fast-forwards both (the watcher does it each tick)
  hq repo archive-history <from> <to> [--dry-run]   move the history of one repo name to another in hq.db and noslop's store (hq hq-archive, and back); backs both up first, refuses on a repeated key or a running noslop
  hq morning [status] | hq morning skip [--date YYYY-MM-DD] --reason T | hq morning tick   the 08:15 Sydney morning-reports job
  hq followup add GEO-n --from repo#n | add GEO-n --backfill --at TIME [--from repo#n] | hq followup [list] | hq followup drop GEO-n   record a review follow-up
  hq typed add --to SESSION --text T|--text-file F --source call:ID|proposal:ID|console:ID|chat:SESSION@TIME   log a line typed into a session as the owner
  hq typed [list] [--session S] [--limit N]   the typed-line log, newest first
  hq mark add --kind skills|grant|hq|other --text T [--ref URL|repo#n|GEO-n] [--at TIME] [--grant NAME] | hq mark [list] [--since 7d] | hq mark drop ID | hq mark grant ID NAME
  hq grant act NAME --target ISSUE|PR|COMMAND [--note T] | hq grant void ACT-ID --reason T | hq grant [actions] [--since 7d]   record an action taken under a named standing grant; void takes back one logged in error; actions lists each named grant with its actions in the window, one line each
  hq fleet [status] [--prompts] | ensure [--dry-run] [--now NAME,...]   the declared z- sessions and stale prompts (--json checks prompts only with --prompts); ensure spawns a missing one (never a duplicate); --now skips the wait for those names (a deliberate re-home)
  hq fleet rc NAME                           the Remote Control helper (ensure starts it after a spawn): types /remote-control once if it is off, never if it is on or unclear
  hq fleet timer install | remove            run ensure every 5 minutes
  hq refusals [--days 7] [--by reason|session|tool]  auto-mode refusals in local Claude transcripts, newest first; --by tallies
  hq refusals scan [--since 14d] [--budget-mb N]  scan the transcripts now (the watcher does it every tick); --since widens the backfill
  hq refs [--days 7]                          each role's skill references and how many of its sessions opened each; zeros first
  hq capacity                                 the newest capacity sample (impd, cloud, Claude, CI, PC), thresholds and open alerts
  hq capacity sample                          read capacity now, store it, send due alerts (the watcher does it every tick)
  hq capacity log [--hours 24]                stored samples, newest first
  hq capacity set KEY VALUE | KEY --reset     set a threshold, or put it back to the default
  hq probe [status] [--days 7]               the Nix uptime probe: last sample and ready check, open outage or unready episode, downtime, outages and unready episodes in the window
  hq probe run                               one check of Nix's /health/live (the timer's command)
  hq probe timer install | remove            run the probe every minute
  hq fleet remove NAME | restore NAME        retire a declared name (ensure never spawns it; drops its wake entry), or take it back
  hq backup [status] | run | test [--remote]  encrypted restic snapshots of hq.db, z-sessions and z- transcripts
  hq backup restore --to DIR [--snapshot ID] [--remote]   restore into an empty directory (never over live state)
  hq backup timer install | remove           the hourly systemd user timer
  hq units scrub                             remove HQ_NOW and HQ_QUIET from the installed units and reload systemd
  hq health [check]                          read-only checks on this PC: units, restart loops, disk, memory, atc, watcher
  hq health settings | set KEY [VALUE]       thresholds (no VALUE: back to the default)
  hq health tick                             one watcher step: tell z-stu about new problems, file news for cleared ones
  hq news [--all] [--limit N]                unread items for the owner, grouped by topic
  hq news add --topic merge|release|deploy|fix|report|other --text T [--from S] [--issue GEO-n] [--link URL] [--tag SLUG] [--needs-geoff]
                                             file one line; only --needs-geoff messages z-stu
  hq news read --upto N                      mark items up to N read
  hq outbox [drop ID]                        unsent messages; drop one
  hq outbox forward FROM TO | forward FROM --remove | forwards   send a retired session's messages to its successor
  hq lanes hold --minutes N --reason TEXT    pause slot nudges (at most 24h; ends by itself) | hq lanes release
  hq lanes ready --lane name=n,... [--ready-total N] [--skipped "GEO-1=reason;GEO-2=reason"]
                                             hq reads the Ready issues from Linear every 10 min; this reports Ready by hand when that read fails (fresh 30 min, a 0 for 3 h), and the nudge then names no issues;
                                             --ready-total is every Ready issue seen in Linear, --skipped the ones not counted, each with a reason
  hq lanes ready --count N                    report a total Ready count only (the old form)
  hq lanes cap                                the cap, if any, and how many sessions are working
  hq lanes cap <n> [--until <ISO time|Ddd HH:MM>] [--reason TEXT]
                                             set the cap; the owner may also raise or lift it, the delivery lead only set or lower it
  hq lanes cap off [--reason TEXT]            lift the cap
  hq lanes skip <issue> --until <ISO time|GEO-n> --reason TEXT
                                             leave one Ready issue out of the lanes' picks until the time passes or GEO-n is Done or Canceled
  hq lanes skip list                          each skip with its until and reason
  hq lanes skip drop <issue>                  end a skip now: the lanes may pick the issue from their next look
  hq focus [show] | clear                     the lanes' focus with each term's Ready and Backlog matches; clear goes back to all eligible work by priority
  hq focus set <term>[,<term>...] [--reserve <area>=<n>]...
                                             steer what free lane slots take, from the next tick; terms in priority order, filters in a term joined by ":":
                                             maintenance|roadmap, bug|feature|chore|improvement|investigation, an area, project=<name>, label=<name>, urgent|high+|medium+;
                                             a reserve keeps n slots for an area and lends them while it has nothing eligible

  hq call|proposal add <id> (--title T --question Q (--body TEXT | --body-file F|-) | --item F|-)
                           [--issues GEO-1,GEO-2] [--for SESSION] [--order N|none]
  hq call|proposal stu <id> --view T
  hq call|proposal open [id] [--force]
  hq call|proposal answer <id> (--answer WORDS | --answer-file F|-)
  hq call|proposal apply <id> --to typed:<session>|linear:<GEO-n>|none [--note T]
  hq call|proposal later <id> [--until ISO|+4h]   default: next 07:00 Sydney
  hq call|proposal skip <id> [--reason T]
  hq call|proposal close <id> --reason T
  hq call|proposal show <id> [--history]
  hq call|proposal list [--state queued,open,...|all]

  hq unblock add (--task T | --item F|-) [--id SLUG] [--minutes N] [--unblocks GEO-1:high,GEO-2:urgent]
                 [--rank N] [--notify z-delivery,...] [--done-when issue:GEO-1|pr:repo#1|doc:ID|release:repo|date:ISO]...
                 [--kind owner|watch] [--deadline ISO]
  hq unblock list [--state open|done|dropped|all]
  hq unblock new | pushed --upto N            items since the last push; move the cursor to N
  hq unblock done|drop <id> [--note T]
  hq unblock later <id> [--until ISO|+4h]   default: next 07:00 Sydney
  hq unblock rank <id> <N|none>
  hq unblock done-when <id> <issue:GEO-1|pr:repo#1|doc:ID|release:repo|date:ISO>...
  hq unblock show <id> [--history]

  hq outbox [list] | hq outbox flush [--retry]  atc messages hq owes other sessions

Who you are: --by, else HQ_AS, else your atc session's name.
